purpose: Test whether the absolute P0671 scalar and tensor fields reproduce spent RX J2129 image positions, roots, multiplicity, parity, and critical topology with no fitted gravity or photon amplitude.

nuisance_fit.source_positions: two coordinates profiled independently for each of seven spectroscopic families on training images
nuisance_fit.map_interpolation: bicubic spline inside the fixed P0671 field; no ellipticity, rotation, radial amplitude, mass sheet, or slip is fitted

global_topology.critical_curve_present: at least one horizontal or vertical sign-changing cell in det(d beta/d theta)
global_topology.parity_diverse: the globally recovered roots for a family contain at least one positive and one negative determinant

selection_rule: The P0669 tensor candidate advances to spent robustness only if it passes every exact-root, predictive residual, compact-halo comparison, global multiplicity, parity, critical-curve, nuisance-bound, and parameter-accounting gate. The heldout images select nothing.
claim_boundary: Every RX J2129 image is spent; P0672 can reject or diagnose the mechanism but cannot validate it.
The global finite seed search can miss roots with very small basins or beyond 48 arcseconds.
Published multiple-image catalogs can omit demagnified, obscured, or unidentified images, so surplus roots are graded by relative magnification rather than all treated as failures.
The 33-cell physical field and bicubic interpolation are coarse for cluster critical curves; a successful topology audit would still require frozen resolution convergence.
P0633 galaxy kinematics and P0640 cluster lens constraints remain sealed.
